system.description:
Five-investigator combat profile

Newly transformed Hausmann, gaunt grey skin, black pupils, fangs, torn charcoal suit and gold left wristwatch. Place him in the actual dark Ward Three corridor position before initiative. Graf is wounded; the intern is already dead. Use this actor instead of the earlier Feral Banker for the default five-person combat.

STRAGIWITEMPArmorFear
753122 / 3 after feeding

Skills: Brawl 4, Force 4, Sneak 3, Investigate 2. Initial Brawl pool 11, or 13 with Blood Frenzy. Reduce pools as current STR falls. Damage: claws 2; bite 3, only with a grapple already held from an earlier action and only on the main activation. Extra successes use normal stunts. No free bite on a grapple.

DA tracking

NPC STR is a number, not an agent-style value/max object. Reduce current STR from 7 by resolved Physical Damage. At 0 he is Broken, cannot attack and loses his extra activation; finish/death follows normal rules. The current system damage helper handles agents only, so adjust this NPC on the sheet manually. Embedded talents list the complete manual encounter rules; they do not install automation. Select STR and supply Brawl 4 in the roll dialog for attacks, plus the conditional +2 when warranted.

Ability reference

Blood Frenzy

+2 Brawl dice against a target currently carrying Physical Damage. Add once to claws, bite or grapple; no bonus for mere bloodstains. Full-strength pool 13; otherwise current STR + Brawl 4 + 2.

Unnatural Tissue — Ballistic Resistance

Resolve normal Armor 2, then halve remaining ballistic Physical Damage, rounding up. A successful brainstem called shot under the normal targeting procedure bypasses halving, not armor. No resistance to melee, fire or other damage types. Manual adjudication.

Feral Surge — Two Initiative Activations

Solo encounter rule for five armed investigators. Draw two initiative cards for this one actor. First activation: normal action allowance. Second: one Slow Action only, for claws, grapple, shove, disarm or movement up to one zone. No bite or extra Fast Action. At most two attacks per round. Share all position, damage and conditions; restrictions affect both slots. No activation while Broken. Record the second card manually if necessary; never add another token.

Wall-Crawler

Move on solid walls and ceilings using normal movement actions and distance. No free movement, disengagement, automatic concealment or teleportation. Grapples and barriers still apply. Telegraph with scraping and an observable position.

Light Vulnerability

Direct sunlight or focused UV causes 2 unsoakable Physical Damage per round of actual exposure, once per round across both activations. Ordinary fluorescent lamps and flashes cause no damage. No spontaneous daylight in the nighttime encounter.

Hunger, Fear and Flight

Fear 2; escalate to 3 when the first bite visibly feeds, using normal Fear timing rather than a new check every activation. Bite grants no healing or automatic infection. At current STR 3 or lower, or with victims sealed away, prioritize the room 3.14 window. Breaking glass and escape require actions and permit interception. No regeneration or reconstitution.

Tactics and counterplay

Telegraph the scrape and silhouette before normal awareness, Fear and initiative. He targets exposed wounded people; investigators can interpose, move Graf into the southeast theatre or deny his path. Firearms still work, particularly concentrated fire; melee bypasses ballistic halving. Restraint, doors and bright illumination of his actual position matter. Never invent UV equipment or claw-transmitted infection.

BM04 has northwest stairs and a northeast lift. The middle north patient room is 3.14 with the exterior window. Telegraph his escape intent, then spend actions reaching and breaking the window. An intercepted escape fails. No hidden relocation, extra monster or revival. If fewer than five cell members enter, omit Feral Surge before drawing initiative and record the chosen version.
system.secret: Hausmann received one phial as cancer treatment. He did not consent to becoming a vampire.
system.goal: Feed while blood is exposed; escape into the night once hurt or denied victims.
system.positiveResult: The cell kills or contains him, or denies his victims and forces an interceptable escape attempt.
system.negativeResult: He injures exposed investigators and may escape through room 3.14 if the route is open.
system.dissolutionMethod: No regeneration or reconstitution. Resolve Broken and lethal injuries normally.

system.description: Slow Action; current STR + Brawl 4, plus Blood Frenzy if applicable. Engaged range. Base Physical Damage 2. Maneuvers replace damage unless normal stunts explicitly allow otherwise.

Main activation Slow Action only. Requires a grapple already held from an earlier action. Current STR + Brawl 4, plus Blood Frenzy if applicable. Base Physical Damage 3, normal defense and armor. No healing, free grapple or automatic infection.
